test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If G % W # K & C @ M, then M is the grand Daughter of G’s ________.
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

Given:

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 @
 &
 #
 %
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Father
 Mother
 Husband
 Sister
 
 

Given, G % W # K & C @ M

 
• G % W means G is sister of W.
 
• W # K means W is husband of K.
 
• K & C means K is mother of C.
 
• C @ M means C is father of M

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a7f7e92fd26e4e76eae39cab2ab33fa4848d671985eee44df6c6c40b1f0305.png] 

According, to the tree diagram 

M is the grand daughter of G's **__brother__**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Brother**.
